sources.name: Steam 热销榜规则
sources.note: 近24小时收入、最近3小时加权，包含本体、DLC与内购，不是售出份数。

sources.name: Steam 当前在线人数
sources.note: 采集时连接Steam的正在游玩人数，不含离线玩家，也不是下载量。

sources.name: Steam 财务数据权限
sources.note: 实际日销量和收入需要对应发行商的财务权限，公开接口无法提供全库数据。

methodology: 动态发现的最多60款独立游戏样本：来自Steam美国区Indie热销/最近发行各前100条，至少有一个紧凑玩法标签，免费或美国区原价不高于25美元；排除DLC、软件、Demo和未发售作品。这些条件只是小体量的筛选代理，不代表已核实团队规模、制作预算或Steam全库排名。
候选按4款热销、1款最近发行轮流检查，符合规则后截取最多60款；所有排名仅在这一发现样本内比较。
近1/7/30天评价量按同一采集时点向前24/168/720小时，以评论创建时间统计；不是评论总数差值，也不是销量。
期间好评率=期间好评数/期间评价量；无评价时不计算比例。全部语言、全部购买渠道，过滤Steam离题评论活动。
当前热销为美国区Indie搜索榜顺位；全球榜位仅引用已核实全球来源的前100榜单，未入榜不视为0。
实时热销按近24小时收入并加权最近3小时，不能解释成纯24小时销量榜。没有公开滚动7/30天销量或下载榜。
商店资料缓存7天，本页数据每日采集、23小时内复用；失败保留旧值及原时间并标记过期，不把缺失写成0。
小游戏是本页筛选口径，Indie和低价本身不证明制作规模；玩法标签包括休闲、解谜、平台跳跃、Roguelite、卡牌、放置等。

games.name: Dressmaker
games.description: Become a dressmaker! Choose fabric, cut out pattern pieces and sew them all together to make the dresses of your dreams - in this cozy crafting game, inspired by real dressmaking.

games.name: Iskabon
games.description: A cursed game demo just merged with your PC's OS. Take part in a high-stakes roguelite deckbuilder with a Russian Roulette twist. Push your luck, trigger wild card synergies, and defeat the glitch to free your computer before the system melts.

games.name: Giggleland
games.description: Tolie isn’t allowed to leave the house. One night she wakes up alone in Giggleland, to a voice over the park speakers: her father is waiting for her at the information booth. A first-person psychological horror game in eight chapters. This game is not suitable for children.

games.name: REKA
games.description: Step into a cozy, witchy world inspired by Slavic folklore. Build, decorate, and customize your walking chicken-legged cottage as you wander through misty autumn woodlands. Help local villagers, tame forest creatures, and learn gentle witchcrafts under the tutelage of the great witch Baba Jaga.

games.name: over the hill
games.description: Explore the world in the golden age of offroading. Drive iconic 4x4 vehicles from the 60s to 80s by yourself or with friends through challenging trails and beautiful scenery.

games.name: Retro Mix 8: Arcade Collection
games.description: Remember the little games that filled whole afternoons? Retro Mix 8 brings eight familiar games together in one single-player arcade collection, from tank defense and fish-eat-fish to tile linking and brick breaking. Come back for one more round!

games.name: Risk of Rain 2
games.description: Escape a chaotic alien planet by fighting through hordes of frenzied monsters – with your friends, or on your own. Combine loot in surprising ways and master each character until you become the havoc you feared upon your first crash landing.

games.name: Brick by Brick: Tidy Up the Small Town!
games.description: Brick By Brick is a relaxing tidy-up game you can play solo or co-op with up to 5 players. Collect, sort, and place 18,490 bricks to rebuild a charming town. Unlock helpful abilities and watch scattered piles become finished buildings. One brick at a time!

games.name: Tape to Tape
games.description: Tape to Tape is a roguelite hockey game where every choice matters on your journey to build the best hockey team. Choose your path, hire unique players, discover synergies between them, pick unique abilities, bribe the referees or visit the Blademaster on your way to restore hockey's former glory.

games.name: FRUIT CATCH: TWO BASKETS
games.description: Catch the right fruit with two baskets! Play with a friend and control one basket each, or take on both baskets alone for a fast-paced multitasking challenge.

games.name: Slay the Spire 2
games.description: The iconic roguelike deckbuilder returns. Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, and discover relics of immense power in Slay the Spire 2!

games.name: ShredDead
games.description: ShredDead is a quirky relaxing incremental zombie-shredding game focused on progression with no lose conditions. Defeat endless waves, collect loot, grow your skill tree and evolve the zombies.

games.name: Balatro
games.description: The poker roguelike. Balatro is a hypnotically satisfying deckbuilder where you play illegal poker hands, discover game-changing jokers, and trigger adrenaline-pumping, outrageous combos.

games.name: IdleOn - The Incremental MMO
games.description: The incremental idle MMO where your heroes keep fighting while you're gone! Spend their loot on upgrades, unlock classes from Elemental-Wizard to Cannon-Pirate, and level 20 unique skills like Farming, Sailing, and Construction!

games.name: Mycopunk
games.description: Cut through fungal aliens in this hyper-customizable, mission based looter shooter. Hundreds of hand-crafted upgrades, 4-player co-op, and a little roach man. What’s not to love?

games.name: Formation Builder Idle
games.description: Every hero changes the heroes beside it. Arrange 46+ heroes on a grid, chain their abilities, and find the layout that multiplies your damage. Then prestige across 21 worlds, fight with mounts, and run missions, mines and a workshop while you're away.

games.name: Stardew Valley
games.description: You've inherited your grandfather's old farm plot in Stardew Valley. Armed with hand-me-down tools and a few coins, you set out to begin your new life. Can you learn to live off the land and turn these overgrown fields into a thriving home?

games.name: Pucked Up
games.description: The oddball hockey deckbuilder. Construct your roster, customize your playbook, and survive a season against teams that will do anything to cheat their way to victory. Outsmart your competition, make the playoffs, and hoist the cup in a league where every run is unique.

games.name: BOMBANANA!
games.description: Chaotic bomb disposal fun with friends & monkeys! Work together as a 3-player co-op team of blind, deaf, and mute monkeys. Each player has only part of the needed information. Communicate, solve puzzles, and race against the clock. Can you defuse the bombs before they explode?

games.name: Don't Starve Together
games.description: Fight, Farm, Build and Explore Together in the standalone multiplayer expansion to the uncompromising wilderness survival game, Don't Starve.

games.name: Rogue Links
games.description: Drive the ball. Fight your way to it. Rogue Links is a top-down action roguelite where every shot is a tradeoff: longer drives save strokes but unleash more monsters. Play the Campaign, Onslaught, the Endless Gauntlet, Daily runs and Head-to-Head, or build and share your own courses.

games.name: Escape the Backrooms
games.description: Escape the Backrooms is a 1-4 player co-op horror exploration game. Traverse 30+ eerie backrooms levels while avoiding entities and other dangers. Try to escape but be warned: survival isn't guaranteed.

games.name: RIVER OF DEAD
games.description: Play as a lone warrior dog defending a vital river from relentless crocodiles in a fast-paced 2D arcade survival game. Master your harpoon, unlock the Power Harpoon, survive the Final Rush, and defeat the River King with 8 direct hits.

games.name: Happy Wheels
games.description: Choose your inadequately prepared racer, and disregard severe consequences in your desperate pursuit of short-lived victory.

games.name: Primal One
games.description: Primal one is a first-person dinosaur survival horror set in an installation in the cretaceous period. Hide and evade dinosaurs that are hunting you, while you try to find a way to go back to the present alive or contact survivors in other installation.

games.name: Machine Party
games.description: Machine Party is a collection of violent party games where failure is lethal. Gather your friends and endure high stakes situations to prove your life is worth more than theirs. Survival is unlikely.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
games.description: Obliterate heretics in the name of the Emperor in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2! Play as Ultramarine Malum Caedo or Sister of Battle Nyra Veyrath in this sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun with MORE enemies, MORE weapons, and NEW ways to purge!

games.name: Punch Upon a Time
games.description: Punch Upon a Time is a team-based party fighter inspired by Smash Bros where you take on rounds of modes, mini-games, and combat alongside your friends. Assemble a squad of the biggest fairy tale names to punch, dunk, fly, score, and sumo your way to victory as the LAST TEAM STANDING.

games.name: Junkpot
games.description: A roguelike about bidding on random storage crates. Read the odds, buy the crate, then stack charms that multiply what falls out. Type combos, rarity bonuses and odds boosts compound into one engine. Build it fast - the quota doubles every round.

games.name: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth
games.description: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth is a randomly generated action RPG shooter with heavy Rogue-like elements. Following Isaac on his journey players will find bizarre treasures that change Isaac’s form giving him super human abilities and enabling him to fight off droves of mysterious creatures, discover

games.name: Lobotomy Corporation | Monster Management Simulation
games.description: A roguelite monster-management simulation inspired by the likes of the SCP Foundation, Cabin in the Woods, and Warehouse 13. Order your employees to perform work with the creatures and watch as it unfolds; harness greater energy, and expand the facility

games.name: Tabletop Simulator
games.description: Tabletop Simulator is the only simulator where you can let your aggression out by flipping the table! There are no rules to follow: just you, a physics sandbox, and your friends. Make your own online board games or play the thousands of community created mods. Unlimited gaming possibilities!

games.name: Brawlhalla
games.description: An epic platform fighter for up to 8 players online or local. Try casual free-for-alls, ranked matches, or invite friends to a private room. And it's free! Play cross-platform with millions of players on PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, iOS, Android & Steam! Frequent updates. Over sixty Legends.

games.name: Return of the Obra Dinn
games.description: Lost at sea 1803 ~ The good ship Obra Dinn.

games.name: Checkmate: The Red General’s Last Move
games.description: Checkmate is a turn-based Xiangqi roguelite where a lone red general carries a cannon into a 9×10 battlefield. Move to reload, fire risky snap shots, aim for precision, and use enemy pieces as firing screens. Each upgrade also strengthens the opposing army.

games.name: The Mortuary Assistant
games.description: Alone with the dead... Embalm corpses, banish demons, save your soul.

games.name: Poppy Playtime
games.description: You must stay alive in this horror/puzzle adventure. Try to survive the vengeful toys waiting for you in the abandoned toy factory. Use your GrabPack to hack electrical circuits or nab anything from afar. Explore the mysterious facility... and don't get caught.

games.name: Cards Rumble: Clash Of Elements
games.description: Cards Rumble: Clash of Elements is a fast-paced competitive strategy card game where Fire, Ice, and Venom collide. Unleash flames, freeze your opponent, and spread venom. Read every move, control the battlefield, and strike at the perfect moment. One decision can turn the tide of battle.

games.name: Bills Must Be Paid
games.description: You're broke, smash piggy banks, bills must be paid. A short active incremental game. Get money, upgrade, and get debt free!

games.name: Twisted Tower
games.description: Blast your way through an abandoned 1950s theme park crawling with fairy-tale mascots, twisted puzzles, and deadly traps. Uncover the dark secrets of your past as you race to the top to win back the love of your life.

games.name: KOTAMON: My Sis Found A Super-Rare Card In Her Cereal Box, So I Became A Garbage Man To Find The Entire Collection And Earn $1,000,000
games.description: Clearing trash can feel even better when you not only make the world cleaner, but also find extra-rare cards that have suddenly increased in price! Rummage through garbage, fulfill the orders from the dump site owner, look for hidden treasures... and collect all the Kotámons!

games.name: Terraria
games.description: Dig, fight, explore, build! Nothing is impossible in this action-packed adventure game. Four Pack also available!

games.name: Hideout Heist
games.description: A co-op horror heist for 1–4 players. Break into a store after dark, grab fragile physics loot and haul it out before the night shift gets you. Hide in the shadows, outsmart guards and worse, and make the quota. The building is different every night. The fun is the same - brand best.

games.name: Obenseuer
games.description: Obenseuer is an urban survival RPG where you become the property manager of a run-down, unfinished tenement building in the isolated quarantine district of Obenseuer. Maintain and upgrade your tenement for rent, uncover the secrets of this infamous district and grow your wealth with your craft.

games.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator
games.description: Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.

games.name: Arctic Roll
games.description: Embark on a relaxing turn-based tactical roguelite adventure. Lead your team of explorers, face dangerous encounters, uncover mysterious artifacts, and unravel the secret behind a strange signal.

games.name: Soul Mates
games.description: You’re trapped inside a haunted house, stalked by angry ghosts. To survive, you’ll have to run, hide, strategize, give gifts, chat, flirt… Wait, what kind of game is this? Oh right, it’s a point-and-click survival horror dating sim!

games.name: Dead Cells
games.description: Dead Cells is a roguelite, metroidvania inspired, action-platformer. You'll explore a sprawling, ever-changing castle... assuming you’re able to fight your way past its keepers in 2D souls-lite combat. No checkpoints. Kill, die, learn, repeat.

games.name: One Million Coins
games.description: A short, focused first-person incremental mining game. Dig through a vault of one million coins, bank your haul, buy better tools, and build an ever-faster gold-collecting operation.

games.name: Circle to another motion
games.description: Your physical intuition will be put to the test. Connect the disc to objects using links and alter its circular motion to guide the target into the box.

games.name: Monster Prom 4: Monster Con
games.description: Can you find love at the nerdiest convention ever? "Monster Con" goes back to the multiplayer dating sim formula: go through absurd and funny situations as you find love among six sexy monsters! Who will you romance? The mimic who cosplays? The idol clown? Or the eldritch cutie? (There's also Liam)

games.name: Rift of the NecroDancer
games.description: The NecroDancer's back in an all-new rhythm game! Dragged into a strange new world, Cadence must engage in musical combat with monsters surging through the Rift! Face pulse-pounding Rhythm Rifts where every beat is a battle, all set to an original soundtrack by Danny Baranowsky & friends.

games.name: Drag'n Wash
games.description: Enjoy a narrative involving 3 male dragons. Wash them, chat with them, touch them, and more! A 3D dragon washing experience.

games.name: OUTVOTE - Steam Version
games.description: How many of your friends would say yes? Answer questions in secret, then guess how the room voted – or call every player's answer. Play with Steam friends, or with anyone in the browser. Free, up to 20 players.

games.name: MIMESIS
games.description: A 4-player online co-op survival horror game. Avoid the contaminated rain, gather scrap and get back to the tram. Monsters that copy your friends' voices and behavior, and many other threats, stand in your way. Gear up and stick together to survive.

games.name: Garry's Mod
games.description: Garry's Mod is a physics sandbox. There aren't any predefined aims or goals. We give you the tools and leave you to play.

games.name: Gunfire Reborn
games.description: Gunfire Reborn is a level-based adventure game featuring FPS, Roguelite and RPG. Players can control heroes with various abilities to experience diverse Build gameplay, use various weapons to explore procedurally-generated levels. You can play the game alone, or join 4-player coop.

games.name: Don't Starve
games.description: Don’t Starve is an uncompromising wilderness survival game full of science and magic. Enter a strange and unexplored world full of strange creatures, dangers, and surprises. Gather resources to craft items and structures that match your survival style.

games.name: Cult of the Lamb
games.description: Start your own cult in a land of false prophets, venturing out into diverse and mysterious regions to build a loyal community of woodland Followers and spread your Word to become the one true cult.

games.name: Fears to Fathom® - Scratch Creek
games.description: After noticing bone-chilling similarities to an episode of Fears to Fathom, Tessa and Marcus decide to share their own experience. Scratch Creek is an exclusively online co-op experience.
